gate: Gate-D step 5 (demand reconstruction), blocked pending an owner decision

why_this_blocks.summary: a route sampler needs one set of hourly edge counts, and the source does not supply one
why_this_blocks.detail: The approved temporal-profile policy fixes fuses_across_dates false, so each series is one site, one direction, one survey date. Producing a single demand artifact therefore requires choosing which survey date represents each site. The owner selected Option A (2019/2022+ post-pandemic window).
why_this_blocks.decided_here: Option A (2019 or 2022+ post-pandemic) is selected by the owner on 25 July 2026.

measured_properties_of_the_source.character: the DfT Manchester raw counts are a 25-year archive of one-off manual surveys, not a synchronised network-wide count
measured_properties_of_the_source.no_common_date: the most widely shared single count_date is 2006-10-03, covering only 6 of 305 sites. There is no date on which even ten sites were surveyed together, so a synchronised network-wide snapshot does not exist in this source.
measured_properties_of_the_source.weekday_note: every site's latest survey falls on a weekday, so no weekend contamination arises from a latest-survey rule

covid_observation.concern: 13 sites were last surveyed in 2020 and 13 in 2021. Those counts reflect pandemic-restricted traffic rather than normal conditions.
covid_observation.consequence: any window that includes 2020 or 2021 mixes restricted-traffic surveys with normal ones, which would bias a calibration target in a direction the calibration cannot detect.
covid_observation.not_decided_here: whether to exclude those years is part of the decision below

decision_table.note: sites and directions here are those that already have a bound edge, so these are the observations demand could actually use. The full bound set is 126 sites and 241 site-directions across 233 distinct edges.

options.caution: fuses surveys spanning 25 years into one demand target, which the temporal-profile policy forbids and which would treat 2008 traffic as contemporaneous with 2025 traffic

what_is_ready_and_waiting.study_subnetwork: built, 285,794 real edges, all 233 bound edges present
what_is_ready_and_waiting.direction_binding: settled after the owner's collinear-fragment ruling: 241 of 311 site-directions bound
what_is_ready_and_waiting.route_sampler_tooling: SUMO 1.27.1 tools/routeSampler.py and tools/randomTrips.py verified present; dfrouter deliberately unused
what_is_ready_and_waiting.remaining_work_once_decided: write the edgeData counts file for the chosen window, generate the fixed route pool, run routeSampler, and preserve its mismatch output
